_note: Control run for the 2026-11 methodology experiments (lr decay / batch size / gamma-lambda / net size / shared network): the 4-deck small league under the CURRENT methodology, from scratch, to 50,000 games/deck (past the entropy/batch schedule horizon of 50k). Everything else is inherited from small_league.json (overlap_collect, training-league twin, history checks + probe suite). EXTENDED 2026-11-16 from 50,000 to 100,000 games/deck to find where the baseline plateaus (continue-vs-stop: the 50,016 state is backed up at checkpoints/small_baseline_50k_backup, and its 50k snapshots stay the anchor). checks_cadence_pct 5 keeps the validation chunk at 5,000 games/deck (cadence = total_games x pct). The 2026-11-13..15 runs (baseline main phase, control, gamma, lr-decay arms) ran with n_workers 10 instead; that is speed-only and does not change what is learned. From 56,640 games/deck on, the run resumes with ppo.max_token_rows 40000 (chunked PPO update, validated 2026-11-16 by the 20k from-scratch run small_chunked20k: same strength as this league at matched ages, 53.3% [51.7,55.0] head-to-head; the update is the same gradient up to rounding, it only bounds GPU memory), so the 50k-100k stretch is a chunked-update continuation of an unchunked first 56k.
